description: For fixed arithmetic terms \(s,t\) and a finite input-name assignment, the specified equality-atom programs return accepted proofs of the actual closed numeral instances of \(s=t\) or \(\neg(s=t)\) on their respective truth branches, in PA models in the fixed ambient universe.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.SignedProofs.equalityPrograms {α : Type}
  [Fintype α] {r : ℕ} (name : α → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.Program r)
  (s t : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Term α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.SignedProofs.SignedPrograms (s.equal t) name
